chunks: Jaḍar ibn al-Mughayra, al-Ṭā’ī, Kufan. Narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) (and he has a book from him).
He was a Khaṭṭābī in his madhhab. Weak in his ḥadīth. His book is not narrated except from a single route.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.خَطَّابِيًّا: Khattabi (a term indicating a scribe or one who records/writes)
key_terms.طَرِيقٍ وَاحِدٍ: Single route (transmitted through one chain only)

ai.seo_question: Who is Jaḍar ibn al-Mughayra and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This biographical entry describes Jaḍar ibn al-Mughayra, a Kufan narrator of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). It notes his status as a 'Kattabi' (likely a scribe or one who writes down narrations), his weakness in hadith transmission, and that his specific book is transmitted through a single chain.

en.tashayyu: 1 – Jaḥdar b. al-Mughayra, al-Ṭā’ī.  Kufan.  Narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh  عليه السلام [and he has a book from him].
He was a Khaṭṭābī in his madhhab.  Weak in his ḥadīth.  His book is not narrated except from a single route.
